about: a mod's .sound tag file as mod_sounds.c reads it over a map's sound (every count, offset and value checked, PCM swapped, Ogg Vorbis decoded through ce_vorbis.c), then given back: the whole mods path from a map's load to its unload with one tag and one file (the Xbox window at 48 TB, above the sanitizer's shadow, as tools/test_map_fuzz.py places it)
